text: Party A shall pay Party B the sum of $5,000 USD within 30 days of the effective date.
The Employer shall remit a monthly salary of VND 15,000,000 to the Employee by the 5th of each month.
Lessor agrees to lease the premises to Lessee for USD 2,500 per month commencing 01 January 2024.
In the event of late payment, Party A shall pay a penalty of 0.05% per day on the outstanding amount.
The Borrower must repay the principal of $50,000 with interest at 12% per annum within 24 months.
Pursuant to Civil Code Article 463, the Lender shall charge interest at a rate of 1.5% per month.
Party B must deliver the goods to Party A by 15 March 2025 as stipulated in this Agreement.
The Employee is entitled to receive an annual bonus of $10,000 if performance targets are met.
Under Law No. 91/2015/QH13, the Seller must issue a VAT invoice for all transactions exceeding VND 200,000.
The Contractor shall complete all construction works by 30 June 2025, failing which a penalty of $500 per day shall apply.
Party A and Party B agree to share profits in equal proportion as set out in Clause 5 of this Contract.
The Licensee shall pay a licensing fee of $1,200 annually to the Licensor starting from 01 April 2024.
According to Article 15 of the Labor Code, the Employer must provide 30 days notice before termination.
The Tenant shall deposit three months rent equivalent to $4,500 USD with the Landlord on signing date.
Any overdue amount shall accrue interest at the rate of 2% per month as stipulated in Law No. 47/2010/QH12.
The Buyer agrees to pay Party A a deposit of $20,000 on or before 10 February 2025.
Party B shall be liable for a penalty not exceeding 20% of the total contract value for any material breach.
The Service Provider must maintain professional indemnity insurance of at least $2,000,000 throughout the contract term.
Pursuant to Section 4.2 of Civil Code 2015, the Obligor shall pay damages amounting to VND 500,000,000 to the Obligee.
The Franchisor shall provide initial training to the Franchisee within 60 days of the signing of this Agreement.
Party A may terminate this Agreement upon 30 days written notice to Party B if Party B defaults on any payment exceeding $10,000.
The interest rate applicable under this loan agreement shall be fixed at 8.5% per annum for the first 12 months.
Employee shall receive a performance bonus of VND 30,000,000 payable on 31 December 2024.
In accordance with Article 7 of Law No. 29/2013/QH13, the Lessor shall return the security deposit of $3,000 within 15 days of lease expiry.
Party B shall not sub-contract any work valued above $25,000 without prior written consent from Party A.
The Assignor hereby transfers all rights under this Agreement to the Assignee effective 01 July 2025.
Pursuant to Law on Enterprises 2020, the Guarantor shall indemnify Party A for losses exceeding USD 100,000.
A late payment penalty of 0.1% per day shall be applied to any amount unpaid after the due date.
The Consultant shall submit a final report to Party B no later than 28 February 2025.
Party A shall not be required to pay any penalty if the delay is caused by a Force Majeure event as defined in Civil Code Article 156.
The Distributor must maintain a minimum monthly purchase of $50,000 and remit payment to the Manufacturer within 14 days of invoice.
As prescribed by Article 385 of the Civil Code, Creditor A is entitled to recover compound interest at 15% per annum on overdue debts.
The Principal shall pay the Agent a commission of 5% of net sales value, settled on the last business day of each quarter.
